Afronomics African Sovereign Bill Index — week of 19 October 2026

The Afronomics African Sovereign Bill Index (ASBI) stands at 12.37% for the week of 19 October 2026, unchanged from the previous week, −11 bps on the month and −203 bps on the year.

Week on week, Ghana fell 4 bps to 9.71%; the other 9 markets had no new one-year result.

The index is the equal-weighted average of the latest 364-day Treasury bill rate in 10 markets. Egypt pays most (25.67%) and Tanzania least (6.28%). The series high is 19.82% (11 March 2024) and the low 9.27% (27 July 2020).

By market (364-day, latest):
• Egypt 25.67% (+0 bps) · 2026-10-13
• Malawi 16.00% (+0 bps) · 2026-09-29
• Nigeria 15.85% (+0 bps) · 2026-10-07
• Mozambique 12.09% (+0 bps) · 2026-10-07

• Zambia 10.00% (+0 bps) · 2026-10-15
• Ghana 9.71% (−4 bps) · 2026-10-19
• Kenya 9.04% (+0 bps) · 2026-10-19
• South Africa 7.53% (+0 bps) · 2026-10-12
• Tanzania 6.28% (+0 bps) · 2026-10-07
